mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ecom_settlement_item WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} ORDER BY posted_date, id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ecom_settlement_item (settlement_id, posted_date, item_type, platform_order_no, seller_sku, amount, description, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.settlementId}, #{i.postedDate}, #{i.itemType}, #{i.platformOrderNo}, #{i.sellerSku}, #{i.amount}, #{i.description}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT platform_order_no AS "platformOrderNo", SUM(CASE WHEN item_type = 'COMMISSION' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS commission, SUM(CASE WHEN item_type = 'FULFILLMENT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS fulfillment, SUM(CASE WHEN item_type = 'REFUND' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS refund, SUM(CASE WHEN item_type IN ('STORAGE', 'OTHER', 'ADJUSTMENT') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS other FROM ecom_settlement_item WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND platform_order_no IS NOT NULL AND platform_order_no <> '' GROUP BY platform_order_no
